correctness.rationale: The logistic coordinate unitary sends C to one-sided exponential convolution R and K_g to R M_ρ R with ρ(s)=x(s)(1−x(s))g′(x(s)); the kernel identity is exact. On stepwise ρ, off-diagonal rectangles have finite rank and diagonal triangular block is a double Volterra kernel up to order-three smoothing. Standard J² singular law h²/(π²n²), finite direct-sum counting, uniform mesh perturbation via weak n^(−2) bounds and exponentially decaying cell tails yield the asserted Weyl coefficient. Variational part independently follows from strict concavity of ∫[x(1−x)]^(−1/2)√p, p=g′≤L: p_max=min(L,k/[x(1−x)]), normalization fixes β and unique max; √p≥p/√L and rearrangement put the minimizing p=L centrally, discontinuous for L>1 and smoothly approximable. β large-L gives Wmax~(2/π²)logL while Wmin~4/(π²L). Independent calculations at L=2,10,100 verified the root equation, ordering and special inf Wmin(2)=2/9. Finite checks do not prove singular-value asymptotics.
